findings.summary: The renewal exceeds the allowed price increase and contains auto‑renewal and notice terms that conflict with Maple Robotics policies, requiring additional approvals before signing.

findings.title: Renewal price increase exceeds 7% cap
findings.detail: The renewal amount is CAD 64,900 versus the prior annual fee of CAD 55,000, an 18% increase, which exceeds the contract's 7% maximum increase.

findings.title: Contractual price‑increase limit breached
findings.detail: The contract permits a maximum annual increase of 7%, but the proposed renewal represents an 18% rise.

findings.title: Automatic renewal clause in order form
findings.detail: The order form adds a clause that the subscription will automatically renew for successive twelve‑month terms unless notice is given.
findings.quote: This subscription will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

findings.title: Notice period for non‑renewal in order form
findings.detail: The order form requires a 60‑day written notice to avoid automatic renewal, shorter than the company’s required 90‑day notice period.
findings.quote: unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

findings.title: Policy on renewal price increases
findings.detail: Company policy states renewals must not increase the annual price by more than 7% and any increase above 7% requires vendor justification and Finance approval.
findings.quote: Software and service renewals must not increase the annual price by more than 7% over the prior term for the same scope. Any renewal above 7% requires written justification from the vendor and approval from Finance before signature.

findings.title: Policy on auto‑renewal clauses
findings.detail: Company policy requires auto‑renewal clauses to be flagged and mandates a non‑renewal notice period of at least 90 days; clauses allowing vendor‑set future prices are not acceptable.
findings.quote: Any auto-renewal clause must be flagged to the requester and to Procurement before signature. Maple Robotics requires a non-renewal notice period of at least 90 days. Clauses that let the vendor set future renewal prices at its then-current list price are not acceptable.
